set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KWY8W7DP7TBKH918WVRG20YW. Problem: the core needs one real ScalaFIM proof, not only toy arithmetic. Build an in-memory domain workflow through the pipeline, likely dataset -> model -> fit -> contrast, and compare to direct public API execution. Acceptance: scenario runs in shared tests where possible; otherwise justify platform boundary; result equality/tolerances are explicit; generic pipeline module does not absorb domain logic.
